text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Command the people of Israel to bring you pure oil of beaten olives for the lamp, that a light may be kept burning regularly.
text_cn: “你吩咐以色列子民给你拿由橄榄榨的清油来，为点灯用，好叫灯光长明不熄。

text_en: Aaron shall set it up in the tent of meeting, outside the curtain of the covenant, to burn from evening to morning before the Lord regularly; it shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.
text_cn: 亚郎应将这灯放在会幕内，约柜帐幔外，自晚上到早晨常点在上主面前：这为你们世世代代是永久的法令。

text_en: He shall set up the lamps on the lampstand of pure gold before the Lord regularly.
text_cn: 亚郎应把这些灯放在纯金台上，在上主面前长燃不熄。

text_en: You shall take choice flour, and bake twelve loaves of it; two-tenths of an ephah shall be in each loaf.
text_cn: 你应拿细面，烤成十二个饼，每个是十分之二‘厄法’；

text_en: You shall place them in two rows, six in a row, on the table of pure gold.
text_cn: 将饼排成两行，六个一行，供在上主面前的纯金桌上。

text_en: You shall put pure frankincense with each row, to be a token offering for the bread, as an offering by fire to the Lord .
text_cn: 每行应撒上纯乳香，作为食物当献与上主的火祭，为获得纪念。

text_en: Every sabbath day Aaron shall set them in order before the Lord regularly as a commitment of the people of Israel, as a covenant forever.
text_cn: 每安息日，应将饼不断地供在上主面前，这是以色列子民因永久的盟约而当行的义务。

text_en: They shall be for Aaron and his descendants, who shall eat them in a holy place, for they are most holy portions for him from the offerings by fire to the Lord , a perpetual due.
text_cn: 这些应归亚郎和他的儿子；他们应在圣地方吃，因为这是上主火祭中至圣之物，是他永享的权利。”

text_en: A man whose mother was an Israelite and whose father was an Egyptian came out among the people of Israel; and the Israelite woman’s son and a certain Israelite began fighting in the camp.
text_cn: 当时在以色列子民中有一个人，他的母亲是以色列人，父亲是埃及人。这以色列女人的儿子在营内与一个以色列人争吵；

text_en: The Israelite woman’s son blasphemed the Name in a curse. And they brought him to Moses—now his mother’s name was Shelomith, daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan—
text_cn: 以色列女人的儿子咒骂亵渎了上主的名，人们就带他去见梅瑟，──这人的母亲名叫舍罗米特，是丹支派狄贝黎的女儿，──

text_en: and they put him in custody, until the decision of the Lord should be made clear to them.
text_cn: 将他看守起来，等梅瑟依照上主的训令给他们处理。

text_en: The Lord said to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 于是上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Take the blasphemer outside the camp; and let all who were within hearing lay their hands on his head, and let the whole congregation stone him.
text_cn: “你带这犯亵渎罪的人到营外去，凡听见他说亵渎话的人，都按手在他头上，然后令全体会众用石头砸死他。

text_en: And speak to the people of Israel, saying: Anyone who curses God shall bear the sin.
text_cn: 你应这样告诉以色列子民说：凡亵渎天主的，应负罪债；

text_en: One who blasphemes the name of the Lord shall be put to death; the whole congregation shall stone the blasphemer. Aliens as well as citizens, when they blaspheme the Name, shall be put to death.
text_cn: 那不避讳‘雅威’之名的，应处死刑，全体会众应用石头砸死他；不论外方人或本地人，若不避讳‘雅威’的名，应处死刑。

text_en: Anyone who kills a human being shall be put to death.
text_cn: 凡打死人的，应处死刑。

text_en: Anyone who kills an animal shall make restitution for it, life for life.
text_cn: 凡打死牲畜的，应该赔偿：以命还命。

text_en: Anyone who maims another shall suffer the same injury in return:
text_cn: 人若加害自己的同胞，他怎样待人，人也怎样待他：

text_en: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth; the injury inflicted is the injury to be suffered.
text_cn: 以伤还伤，以眼还眼，以牙还牙；他怎样害了人，人也怎样害他。

text_en: One who kills an animal shall make restitution for it; but one who kills a human being shall be put to death.
text_cn: 凡打死牲畜的，应该赔偿；凡打死人的，应处死刑。

text_en: You shall have one law for the alien and for the citizen: for I am the Lord your God.
text_cn: 为你们，不论是外方人或是本地人，只有一样法律；因为我上主是你们的天主。”

text_en: Moses spoke thus to the people of Israel; and they took the blasphemer outside the camp, and stoned him to death. The people of Israel did as the Lord had commanded Moses.
text_cn: 梅瑟这样训示了以色列子民；他们就把这犯亵渎罪的人带到营外，用石头砸死。以色列子民全照上主吩咐梅瑟的做了。
